TOWNSHIP OF EXAMPLE
PLANNING BOARD / ZONING BOARD OF ADJUSTMENT
SITE PLAN APPLICATION CHECKLIST
(Pursuant to N.J.S.A. 40:55D-10.3)

Items marked (W) may be waived by the Board upon written request. Items marked (NW) are not waivable.

GENERAL REQUIREMENTS – ALL APPLICATIONS
1. Completed application form, signed by the applicant and owner. (NW)
2. Application and escrow fees per Section 190-70. (NW)
3. Certification that taxes are paid to date. (NW)
4. Certified list of property owners within 200 feet. (NW)
5. Corporate disclosure statement pursuant to N.J.S.A. 40:55D-48.1. (NW)
6. Twelve (12) copies of plans at 24" x 36" and one digital PDF copy. (W)

PRELIMINARY MAJOR SITE PLAN
7. Key map at a scale of not less than 1" = 1,000' showing the site in relation to surrounding streets and zone boundaries.
8. Zoning table listing required, existing and proposed bulk standards and all variances requested. (NW)
9. Boundary and topographic survey signed and sealed by a New Jersey licensed land surveyor, with contours at 2-foot intervals extending 100 feet beyond the property. (W)
10. Grading and drainage plan with spot elevations. (W)
11. Stormwater management report demonstrating compliance with N.J.A.C. 7:8, including soil permeability testing. (W)
12. Landscape plan prepared by a licensed landscape architect. (W)
13. Lighting plan with photometric data and fixture details. (W)
14. Environmental Impact Statement per Section 190-35. (W)
15. Architectural floor plans and elevations. (W)
16. Soil erosion and sediment control plan. (W)
17. Utility plan showing sanitary sewer, water, gas and electric service. (W)
18. Sign plan showing location, size, and illumination of all signs. (W)
19. Truck turning templates and sight triangle easements. (W)
20. Aerial photograph of the site and surrounding 200 feet. (W)
21. Construction details for all site improvements. (W)
22. Traffic impact study prepared by a licensed professional engineer for any use generating more than 100 peak hour trips. (W)
